The '''Palace of Memnii''' was a structure built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]] by the native [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]], which housed millions of first-person accounts made by beings from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] who had confronted violence during their lives.<ref name="EGTW:AC" />

Amongst the oldest recordings in the Palace was an account given by an [[Unidentified Republic soldier (Falang Minor)|anonymous soldier]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who had been stationed on the planet [[Falang Minor]] in around [[24,000 BBY]], after the end of the [[Tionese War]]. The story was recorded on a [[Baragwin sense lattice]], but due to the loss of the algorithm used to access the visuals, only the audio recording was available to listen to.<ref name="EGTW:AC" />

The Palace was destroyed in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] during the [[Caamas Firestorm|Devastation of Caamas]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], although some of its records, including part of the Republic soldier's story, survived as they were part of a traveling exhibit at the time.<ref name="EGTW:AC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Palace of Memnii was first mentioned in [[2013]] in the fourth instalment of ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'', a series of posts on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] featuring material cut from ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''. The post was written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].
